rationale: Builds directly on the current late-aligned recurrent-tail best and changes only the tail recurrence carry path: each recurrent tail block now reuses its own first-pass output as the block-local anchor instead of falling back to the global embedding anchor. That is a minimal gated-carryover transplant in an underexplored local category, keeps the winning late decoder skip alignment intact, adds no new modules or extra forward passes, stays byte-neutral on the quantized artifact, and preserves the exact final int8+zlib evaluation path.
title: First-Pass Output Carryover For Recurrent Tail
